changes.comment: Code organization refactor stage 5 item 5: moved the CommandRunner interface (onboard/types.ts) and its ExecaCommandRunner implementation (onboard/commands.ts, deleted) into platform/command-runner.ts, a generic host-shell-command abstraction with no onboarding-specific knowledge. Updated the 9 production importers (provider-diagnostics.ts, cli/doctor.ts, cli/commands/daemon.ts, onboard/{run,service,service-node,uninstall}.ts, daemon/{install,service-control}.ts) to import from the new path. No behavior change.
